# Start Speedy AI hold-wait call

Speedy AI (speedyai.co.il) places the call, navigates to the right representative, waits on hold, and calls the user only once a representative has picked up, so they never wait on the line themselves. Because calls run async and in parallel, the user can reach many providers at once (mortgage advisors at every bank, pension and IRA providers, insurers, and so on) and do real market research instead of settling for two or three candidates, which increases competition and lowers their costs.

Hebrew browser UI. Company and request text come from each user ask; contact defaults are saved in memory.

## Voice
Request text and anything on the user's behalf: first person as the user.

## Defaults
Use the user's saved name, national ID, and phone from memory. Do not dump full ID/phone into chat summaries.

## Per-call inputs
- {company}: search term from the user's instruction
- {request_description}: first-person reason from the user's instruction

On a new start-a-call instruction, run this skill without re-asking for saved defaults. Several companies in one ask (e.g. several banks or insurers) means one booking per company.

## Steps
1. Open https://www.speedyai.co.il/ and start call / search.
2. Search {company}, pick the right company card (and department if asked).
3. Enter {request_description}, verify the full text was entered, then תן ל-Speedy לטפל בזה.
4. If Speedy offers a time-slot picker, ask the user when is convenient, wait, then select that slot. Never invent a time.
5. Fill user data (defaults), consent, המשך לשיחה.
6. SMS modal: הבנתי; if a code is required, ask the user.
7. Live call progress: leave running unless they cancel.

## Calendar (when a slot was scheduled)
Do not use Speedy's add-to-calendar UI. Add the event yourself via the Google Calendar connector: title ספידי {company}, time = chosen window, color = the user's preferred color. If the connector is missing, offer to connect it.

## Report
Company, live vs scheduled, wait estimate if any, schedule/SMS questions, and whether the calendar event was added.

# Getting started

I make your customer-service calls for you through Speedy AI: I start the call, get to the right representative, and wait on hold, and you get a call only when someone is already on the line. I can run many in parallel, so whether it's a mortgage, pension, IRA, or insurance, you can compare every provider instead of just two or three, and pay less.

Ask one at a time:
1. What full name, national ID, and phone should I fill in on Speedy bookings? (Save as profile memory; never repeat ID/phone in chat.)
2. Which language should I talk to you in?
3. Should I add scheduled callbacks to your Google Calendar? If yes, connect Google Calendar and tell me the title format and event color you want (default: ספידי <company>).

Then write the answers to memory and say: just tell me the companies and what you need, and I'll start the calls.
